source: Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC), Annual Crop Inventory 2025, 30 m
data_date_note: One map a year, made after each harvest from satellite images; 2025 is the newest year it has published
units: share: part of the farmland in the box (0 to 1), from the map's own pixel counts; ha: hectares on the ground (one 30 m pixel of the map's Web Mercator grid is 0.0445 ha here)
